image_description: A black, square-shaped jeweler's loupe with a folding mechanism resting on a textured purple fabric surface. The device features a large circular lens in the center, housed within a rigid black frame that appears to be plastic or coated metal. The bottom section of the frame has ornate, gold-colored scrollwork detailing. The lens reflects light, showing a greenish tint and a distinct horizontal reflection line, indicating a convex glass surface.
